name: claude-api
specialty: Pay-as-you-go Claude on its own API key and Console workspace: reviews, and takes overflow builds when the Max agents are rate-limited.
apiKeyEnv: the API key the user provides when asked
notes: Runs `claude -p --model sonnet --output-format json` (the JSON result carries total_cost_usd, which feeds the spend ledger). Never `--bare`: it turns off plugins, agents and skills, and the docs say it will become the default for -p, so a test pins the command without it.

the API key the user provides when asked is injected only into this child's environment (scripts/api_keys.py), after the env scrub. CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR points at the agent's own folder under the harness user dir (agents-home/claude-api), so it never picks up the Max OAuth login.

Reviewer and overflow builder only; never lead or sign-off (leadEligible false). The builder is reachable only when the roster rules allow `build` and read_only is false; the defaults do not. The lead applies and commits its work.
